docs.title: Welcome to the Mindustry Mod Wiki!
docs.text:
this is an unofficial wiki, automatically generated and updated daily

mods show up on this wiki if they are on the mod browser, have at least 10 stars, and can run on build 158.1

a few mods might not show up due to errors during the loading process

only around 250 mods can actually be shown here due to github REST API rate limit

docs.title: Combat Dustry
docs.text:
Property Value Author Rustedbeee Repository https://github.com/new-guys5634/mechy-chaos Stars 11 Last updated 2026-04-06T19:42:15Z

Meet shardsShards is located far away from the sun and is basically frozen with tiny bugs of radiation.Although this planet has units, most of the time you'll be fighting walking mushrooms which is infected by lushion and droxium.This mod is also filled with random stuff and after the fifth sector it's basically unplayable as it'll be unbalanced.Also I'm actively reworking every sector.Note that kjol and cold moon is being removed and is rather be kept as a normal moon.

docs.title: Allure
docs.text:
Property Value Author Elixias Adrys Repository https://github.com/lixiewulf/allure Stars 229 Last updated 2026-04-09T23:52:42Z

Contributors: Sh1penfire (world logic)⚠ PERFORMANCE WARNING: This mod may crash or misbehave on weaker PCs and phones.Best played with a completely fresh campaign save. Currently in development. Description will try to increase player engagement later.Allure is a large RTS mod that attempts to bring a true start-to-finish storyline to the table. And also hardcore gameplay. Enjoy being swarmed by the bee legion. This mod is planned to introduce an overhauled vanilla experience, with sweeping changes across every aspect of Serpulo. Maps are redone, tutorials added.What comes after? Well, I guess we'll have to find out. I'm not giving you any spoilers. You'll find out if you're curious.Enabling this mod will break every Serpulo schematic until disabled. Be careful, well, if you like yours. Works on beta build 157. Edit the mod.hjson's minGameVersion to use.

docs.title: Glistening Ocean
docs.text: A hidden, highly developed Crux base revealed by communications from their launch site. Capture it, and use it to reveal any more hidden strongholds.

docs.title: Infested Valley
docs.text:
A narrow, isolated valley in the northern mountains.

Two small enemy bases have built up here. Eradicate them with Minke units and take their new research. Expect attacks from two sides.

docs.title: Jagged Heights
docs.text: Jagged, sharp shale cliffs lie infested with enemy infrastructure to the north. The enemy appears to have engineered a new drill here, faster than your basic drills. Eradicate the bases quickly. Push the enemy back. Steal their pneumatic drills, and perhaps find a new alternative.

docs.title: Overgrown Basin
docs.text:
Once a lush basin, now overtaken by spores. The enemy has set up a production base here. Claim it for your own. Use your new Flare units to whittle them down. Use Crawler units to open breaches for your daggers.

The ample moisture and nutrition at this site have led to an excessive overgrowth of spore. It is likely that these nearby basins contributed to their rapid and destructive spread.

docs.title: Plagued Islands
docs.text: A small, infested lake lies nestled between frigid mountain ranges. Spore has devastated the land, spreading rapidly over the marshes. The enemy has built a major production factility here. Steal their Nova and silicon smelter blueprints. Use this new unit against them.

docs.title: Power Research Outpost
docs.text: The ruins of a long-abandoned research base lie in the untainted mountains to the south. Extensive flooding has destroyed most of the advanced technology here. The enemy is starting to notice our presence globally. Research the Arc turret and steam generator. Fend off the enemy's army.

docs.text: With Brine present in this Sector, brine electrolysis can be used for power generation.

docs.title: Feldspar Ravine
docs.text: Gerbs utilise dead bodies of their soldiers to turn them into soulless mashines. Utilise biotite leaching vessel to gain aluminium and ferric matter

docs.title: Lagoon
docs.text: A highly defended strategic landform. Utilize strategy as the enemy has set a very strong foothold here.

docs.title: Blasted Dockyard
docs.text: An old home. Currently under siege, this will truly be a challenge.

docs.title: Coupled Basin
docs.text: Crux fortifications support a patrol moving through this area. Secure and destroy the patrol.

docs.title: Dried Riverbed
docs.text: A bottleneck in Crux' logistic network.Destroy their convoy to break their hold over this region. Preliminary scoutings have confirmed the presence of tier 5 units. Prepare accordingly.

docs.title: Eroded Canyon
docs.text: A crux strike team guards this waterway, this waterway is required to access the North Gate

docs.title: Floodplains
docs.text: This waterway is required to access a strategic crossroads. Destroy and move on.

docs.title: Frigid Shores
docs.text: A crux naval strike team has blockaded this waterway, preventing access to the dockyard complex. Destroy and move on.

docs.title: Frozen Lake
docs.text: A large proportion of this sector is taken up by a lake. The enemy is likely have a naval presence. Prepare accordingly. There is also a lack of sand here, utilise scrap centrifuges to obtain it.

docs.title: Fungal Tropics
docs.text: A crux patrol watches over this area, secure and move on.

docs.title: Galena Fringe
docs.text: A very deep trench with high amounts of geothermal activity. Rich in galena formations.

docs.title: Lakeside Library
docs.text: Houses mostly distribution-related knowledge, no enemies are present. It is not required to enter this place.

docs.title: Lowland Strait
docs.text: A rogue crux naval patrol has stranded themselves here. Destroy and move on.

docs.title: Mountainside Complex
docs.text: A crux branch is attempting to re-acquire advanced weaponry in a fortified research outpost. Destroy and move on.

docs.title: Resurgence
docs.text: A perfect area to get past the orbital defense, our conquest begins here.

docs.title: Seared Wastes
docs.text: There is a crux patrol traveling these deserts. Destruction of this patrol is necessary to move forward.

docs.title: Stormy Coast
docs.text: This sector seems to have near constant raging storms. Land during a calm and prepare. It is recommended to start setting up some shields once the rain starts.

docs.title: Submerged Canyon
docs.text: You have stumbled upon one of their supply routes. Utilize the canyon structure in order to block off the convoys.

docs.title: Twin Pass
docs.text: Defunct ruins scatter these wastes. Destroy the crux patrol and move on.

docs.title: Verdant Shallows
docs.text: A region of Tantros where the ocean is particularly shallow. Don't let the seeming tranquility of this sector fool you, Gerb are present.

docs.title: Violet Valley
docs.text: A valley filled with plenty of spore growths; Varcaud Stalks tower over Brulr Fern, Brambles and Rel Blossoms. Kol Ferns and Adre Sprigs grow aplenty on the overgrown floor. For as of yet unknown reasons Crux has sent an expeditionary group into this valley. The destruction of this expedition would hinder Crux' plans.

Hybrid mod primarily built around a gradually branching campaign that expands in multiple directions.The mod adds a new planet, Gelion, featuring its own campaign, star system, research tree, and gameplay mechanics.The planet offers over 90 blocks to research, 12 units each with their own unique abilities, 12 campaign sectors, more than 6 new mechanics, and plenty of room for map creation.On top of that, the campaign also stands out with absolutely BRUTAL visual effects. Every texture was made with care and dedication.THIS MOD IS STILL IN DEVELOPMENT!The current completion percentage is approximately 57%, with plenty of room to grow!Help me develop the mod! Join the Azimuth Discord server using the link in the README file on the mod's official GitHub page.///////////////////////////////Land on a sub-cryonic terra slowly heating up beneath its unstable star. The celestial body is suffering from global warming — glaciers are melting, atmospheric pressure is rising, and temperatures continue to climb.Exterminate the enemy faction. Witness a world that will soon become ash.If you enjoyed the mod, please consider giving it a star!Thank you for playing.///////////////////////////////Developers:Code: DeerCarbonateSprites: DeerCarbonateMaps: DeerCarbonateLocalization: DeerCarbonateSpecial Thanks:Music: ACE — "the last fight", "in orbit", "create", "smth far away"; garretski — "Azimuth", "Rhumb".Maps: Kivet/БОБ — "Cold Harbor"; Fate of Adrastus — "Tight Caverns"; Alpotat — assistance with the map "Arrival".Code: KOSTOLOM

docs.title: Northern Pass
docs.text:
Set out for the coldest, snow-covered regions of the planet to extract a new type of resource.

The harsh climate and confined terrain will create resource scarcity — use what you have wisely.

docs.title: Thicket
docs.text:
In this temperate climate, vegetation is becoming increasingly widespread. The name of this place is no coincidence—it comes from the rapid and abundant growth of flora here.

Begin investing in the decoder. Establish your defenses. Make use of the unique resource for research.

Unlike spores, silicon-based lifeforms are relatively non-aggressive and highly useful for industrial purposes. Two of the most advanced types stand out immediately. Here, they coexist in harmony, showing no signs of competing for survival or dominance—an unusual and fascinating behavior.

docs.title: Tight Caverns
docs.text:
Within vast mountain ranges, sun-exposed fissures are often found.

Use technological superiority to destroy the enemy base and advance forward.

docs.title: Arrival
docs.text:
Low enemy activity makes this sector ideal for researching early technologies.

Automate production and push forward.

docs.title: Wilderness
docs.text:
This sector’s ruins contain technologies that will support your future expansion.

Expect heavy enemy resistance as they attempt to safeguard this information.

docs.title: Cold Spot
docs.text:
In the cold haze, an enemy base exists.

Study the new gold-like material and create the Arbiter, a heavy ground unit, to capture the enemy base.

Mining two materials with similar electrochemical properties may seem inefficient. However, in this case it is a necessary step to advance further.

docs.title: Frozen Frontier
docs.text:
A chain of archipelagos spreads along the flooded channels.

The enemy stronghold maintains control of the airspace, cutting off the route to the north. A successful assault will require deploying two different types of combat units. Stay alert — the enemy will put up heavy resistance.

The Seekers of Inferno have always been known for their technological progress. After signing a research agreement with the Aggressors, their air defense systems were improved so much that the passage to the north is now blocked by a massive firing zone. In addition, parts of the equator and the southern regions are also under strict airspace control.

docs.title: Melting Channels
docs.text:
Where ancient glaciers once stood, a vast network of flooded channels now stretches across the region.

Due to the rugged terrain, you will need to rely on hovers — agile combat units capable of traversing most obstacles.

docs.title: Estuary
docs.text:
Further along the equator, there is a recently formed estuary.

No enemy activity has been detected in the sector. Turn the sector into a resource outpost and advance further.

docs.title: Cold Harbor
docs.text:
The flooded harbor severely limits your choice of combat units. To destroy the two enemy cores, you will have to rely on ships.

Use the long-range capabilities of ships to gain the upper hand in the siege of the enemy base.

docs.title: Arched lakes
docs.text:
The thicket borders a pair of stagnant lakes that are periodically replenished by local rains. The arches that loosely divide the lakes appear to be supported by cobalt rods.

Destroying the enemy base will firmly secure our position in this region. Use “Ferrymen” - long-range naval units that will put heavy pressure on the enemy base’s logistics.

docs.title: Coastal zone
docs.text:
Amid the mountainous terrain lies a vast coastal zone.

Enemy presence is blocking further advancement. Research and produce a new resource. Defend against the waves, destroy the enemy base, and advance further.

Sticks of the Yutnori, a Korean traditional board game. Game Rules:  Do. Move one space forward.  Ge. Move two spaces forward.  Geol. Move three spaces forward.  Yut! Move four spaces forward, and roll again.  Mo! Move five spaces forward, and roll again.  Back-do. Move one space backward. If you are at the first space, your position will underflow and go right to the goal! You should also roll again when your move lands on an enemy space, sending the enemy to the start too. Rerolls stack, meaning one can win this game in just one turn, but extremely unlikely.

docs.title: BitingGlacier
docs.text: Group BOSS Map The frigid environment has given rise to these massive ice spikes, with northern mountain ranges covered in thick ice layers. Further up lies the origin point of Wulfrum, where Wulfrum frequency signals are strongest.

docs.title: Dry Sands Oilfield
docs.text: MinBOSS Map A desert occupied by several Wulfrum bases, showing signs of past wars. Data indicates Oil resources beneath the sand. Surface traces of underground lava flows exist. Use lava for power generation. Extract Oil to produce Plastanium. Surface Coal deposits can be utilized. Water must be somewhere.

docs.title: Floating Ice Bay
docs.text: BOSS Map An Arctic inlet with volcanic activity. The sea surface has extensive ice floes. Shallow waters between floes provide passage. Wulfrum defenses here are stronger than other regions. Gather resources, build a base, capture this area.

docs.title: Misty Outpost
docs.text: A tranquil forest with a river, housing several unclaimed constructs' bases. Begin your journey here. Destroy bases, research technology.

docs.title: Haze Ravine
docs.text: BOSS Map A mountainous area. Higher-tier Wulfrum machines are entrenched here. Await Reinforcements. Develop and destroy all enemy cores.

docs.title: Meteorite Basin
docs.text: A basin downstream from the river valley. Houses several Wulfrum bases and an energy-emitting meteorite crater. This area has Chromium deposits for ship construction.

docs.title: Turbulent Valley
docs.text: A valley with fast-flowing water. Houses 2 Wulfrum bases. Resources are not abundant. Destroy bases, research technology.

docs.title: Vast Lake
docs.text: MinBOSS Map A lake with a Wulfrum water base. Transport and ground unit movement are difficult here. Use Payload devices for resource transport. Attack with Hover units and navy.

docs.title: Carpe Diem
docs.text:
Property Value Author Nullotte Repository https://github.com/nullotte/carpe-diem Stars 46 Last updated 2026-06-23T10:20:54Z

A peaceful campaign mod which focuses on factory building.Build production lines, decode archives, and launch landing pods across the sectors of Asphodel, a cold planet ravaged by the forces of war. Salvage what remains of the Coalition, and restore their industry to its former glory.This mod is mostly complete in terms of implemented content, but its campaign is still unfinished. Either way, I hope you'll enjoy what the mod has to offer.

docs.title: Forward Outpost
docs.text:
The way forward. A humble outpost located on a river near the reserve, built by the Coalition during the war in order to expand their forces. The base has long since been reduced to rubble, though there may still be some important structures left in the ruins.

A more advanced landing pod will be necessary to continue from here. Assemble and launch a Guided Landing Pod using the technology found in this sector.

docs.title: The Reserve
docs.text:
A time capsule hidden far away from the rest of the planet, only to be booted up in case of an emergency.

Something must have gone horribly wrong here.

Begin building factories and automating products. Explore the land, searching for anything that can be salvaged. Figure out how to construct and launch a Crude Landing Pod in order to move on to the next sector.

docs.title: Core: Cultivation
docs.text:
Being the single place the Cultivation resides, this core has monstrous amounts of health, and armor only titans can break through [This technology is far too advanced to replicate]

Property Value General Health 1200000 Armor 95 Size 16x16 Build Time 815 seconds Build Cost 5.0k 8.5k 15k 4.0k 1.5k Max Active Units +250 Items Item Capacity 2147467.2 items Function Unit Type Shatter Point

This core, alongside it's unit, was creating from the brilliant mind of Korroda Xavier. Xavier was a smart man, responsible for the creation of most of 's larger units, such as the annihilate. When the war for ’s future begun, he was tasked with creation a machine capable of pushing their production to maximum efficiency, removing any obstructions. At first he refused. He knew such a thing had a chance to factor in their race as an obstruction, even if he specifically told it not to. But in fear of execution he reluctantly created their near flawless schematics. He gave his last warnings, left without a trace. He gotten threats many times before, but this was his breaking point. They were foolish, nieve not to heed his warnings. They brought their annihilation upon themselves.

In the meantime, it remains to wait. Sorry for the inconvenience.Important:This mod does not bring anything radically new to the game, but only expands the combat functionality of existing combat units.Please pay attention:The mod significantly redesigns units, changes the balance and generally complicates the game. docs.title: Abandoned Factory
docs.text: There was a factory, where technology is researched. Use it to give the Malis base a taste of their own medicine.

docs.title: Blade Base
docs.text: This place has extremely large deposits of bare thorium. Collect, capture and move on.

docs.title: Cores Trap
docs.text: Extensive scans show that the landing position is conveniently in between two enemy cores. Do not underestimate this base unless you know what you're doing.

docs.title: The Fort
docs.text:
This place has a fort. Survive.

Seems that the router really likes tomfoolery.

docs.title: The Armored Centre
docs.text: After careful consideration, we have realised that this "armored centre" is a trap made by the router entity. Prepare for the worst.

docs.title: Connection
docs.text: This sector will be a great place to use payload related mechanics. A lesser enemy base has also been found.

docs.title: Omega Outpost
docs.text: A not-so well-fortified fortress is found in this sector, providing a convenient boost in resources. Destroy the base, leaving nothing behind.

docs.title: Rubidium Fortress
docs.text: A new material has been detected — rubidium. Get this material and destroy the erected malis fortress.

docs.title: Great Rubidium Wall
docs.text: There was a big red stone wall placed there. The beryllium and tungsten walls there have anomalous species, basically rendering walls of said resources less doable to use. All attacks are expected to be flying units.

docs.title: The Source
docs.text:
The source of hacking has been detected. Destroy the aforementioned source, leaving nothing behind and permanently deleting the enemy's power source.

Despite being eradication tier difficulty it is actually extreme difficulty only due to budget cuts. Also expect thoriumgon.

docs.title: Commarchya

docs.title: Concave

docs.title: Cornered

docs.title: Desolate Corridor
docs.text: A seemingly abandoned outpost from an obsolete team has been detected here. Attacking it may cause retaliation from large waves of different types of units, including potential tier 6 units.

docs.title: Erebus
docs.text: A stalemate beetween an ancient team's stronghold and a malis base. End it and take the sector's plentiful ressources.

docs.title: Junction
docs.text: The intersection beetween two small ravines. A small malis production outpost has been detected here along with the passage of units from an unknown team.

docs.title: Faultline
docs.text: A system of rifts and fissures has caused a depression to form, giving way to a slag river through wich ennemy boat units will pass. Research the Shelling turret to better deal with the great amounts of ennemies of the later waves.

docs.title: Fissure
docs.text: 2 intersecting fault lines have caused a deep depression to open in the ground. A large amount of ennemy units come through here. The afflict turret and surge walls will be required to stand a chance against the later waves.

docs.title: Interlude
docs.text: The malis is on its last leg. Destroy the large amount of high tier units here and go on.

docs.title: Ovoid
docs.text: No usual radar signatures detected, however there might still be an ennemy base here. You will be attacked immediatly upon landaing, be careful.

docs.title: Magmatic Sinkhole

docs.title: Blazing River

docs.title: Etigei Exile
docs.text:
Property Value Author Mitemi & Tikup Repository https://github.com/reversteams/etigei-exile Stars 14 Last updated 2025-12-05T16:09:25Z

Etigei Exilium is the successor to the old Etigeox mod, featuring two planets and adding 169 blocks, 23 items, 22 units, and 22 sectors with content from the Etigeox universe. Establish colonies on the frozen planet of Neoulandia, a new campaign with its own tech tree, destructible environment, such as destructible trees from which you can harvest timber, emphasis on unit cargo, and unique map design. The entire Neoulandia campaign is interconnected with each map having direct connections to other maps, branching into economy-focused sectors, classic survival or attack maps. Rubiginosus presents a collection of hardcore maps, inspired by Rusted Warfare, initially designed for multiplayer using Serpulo and Erekir technology. These missions have been retrofitted for a campaign experience with unique challenges for each map. Completing the Rubiginosus campaign will unlock a special resource on Neoulandia.Requires Timber (EDT) as a dependency.Discord: https://discord.com/invite/TJKZgr6UDg

docs.title: Landing Ground
docs.text:
Tutorial Mission: Landing Ground

Welcome to Neoulandia, governor! As a governor of Etigeox Federation colonies on the planet of Neoulandia, you will be tasked with establishing a suitable starting colony before the Colonial Authority will accept to fund more expeditions and colonization efforts. This includes higher levels of technology.

docs.title: Scouting Party
docs.text:
Survival Mission: Scouting Party

Unkown signals have been detected south of your first colony. We predict that these will be Neo-Antarctican signals. Defeat their scouting expedition so that they may not inform their bases of presence.

docs.title: Forking Pathways
docs.text:
Attack Mission: Forking Pathways

We have detected a small outpost in the southern ice mountains. These are not mountains proper, but rather gigantic ice sheets. The Neo-Antarcticans managed to create a pathway through the mountain, however their forces are pouring through the valley. Defeat both of their combined forces before a greater threat arrives.

docs.title: Shrouded Assault
docs.text:
Attack Mission: Shrouded Assault

The enemy has a well-hidden base deep in the icebergs. You will be tasked with finding and assaulting the base from the east side. This base contains valuable research materials.

docs.title: Precursory River
docs.text:
Economic Mission: Precursory River

No enemy signals have been detected in this region. Exploit the region's resources and fulfill your taxation requirements to the metropole.

docs.title: Serorjoen Mountains
docs.text:
Construction Achievement Mission: Serorjoen Mountains

Governor, you have managed to reach the foot of the Serorjoen mountain range, the largest mountain range on the planet. You will need to commit significant resources to the construction of a great tunnel across the mountains.

docs.title: Ice Spikes
docs.text:
Survival Mission: Ice Spikes

Hillier terrain awaits in the south. The Neo-Antarcticans have multiple pathways to enter the region. Use the strategic choke points within the region to block their advance.

docs.title: Collier Chamber
docs.text:
Economic Mission: Collier Chamber

Find your way to the southern end of the caverns and establish a zone of control.

docs.title: Waterfall
docs.text:
Economic Mission: Waterfalls

New and rarer resources have been detected in this sector. This will aid you in acquiring newer technology.

docs.title: Dividing Titanium
docs.text:
Mission 1: Dividing Titanium.

The United Earth and the League of Independant States are fighting for control of the titanium within this area. It is your time to take command. Defend our newly established colony and take over their titanium mines to the East. A mercenary force was also hired to hinder our progress.

[Mod Author Notes: This is a hardcore seperate campaign initially designed for multiplayer play, heavily inspired from Rusted Warfare, before being ported into a modded campaign. This planet uses Serpulo and Erekir technology. It is recommended to have researched most of the relevant tech trees before engaging with the campaign. The quality of the maps are not assured, but improve with every map.]

docs.title: Naval Strike Force
docs.text:
Mission 10: Naval Strike Force.

Our allied forces lay besieged by the enemy. Lead an Aircraft Carrier strike force to lift the siege and assert our dominance over the region once and for all.

docs.title: Ice Raid
docs.text:
Mission 2: Ice Raid.

After obtaining titanium, we must take down the League's fortresses in the north. Break the stalemate and end their time in the frozen icey mountains.

docs.title: Cross Assault
docs.text:
Mission 3: Cross Assault.

This island is split between our forces, the League and Independant mercenaries. The defences of both of their bases appear shaky. Which one shall we take down first?

docs.title: Sneeky Breeky
docs.text:
Mission 4: Sneeky Breeky.

The League is very well entrenched from one side, however a secret lab and an unexploited piece of land aren't under their control. Strike from where is unexpected and be in control. It appears that the League has not detected our arrival and their reinforcements will be delayed as a result.

docs.title: Desert Highs
docs.text:
Mission 5: Desert Highs.

When the hope of new beginnings burned our eyes. The League has established their fortress in the desert and is slowly colonising the region. Capture the sector in the name of the United Earth. It is impossible to use air support due to heavy sandstorms.

docs.title: Snowy Domain
docs.text:
Mission 6: Snowy Domain.

Fall Blau.

docs.title: Molten Stronghold
docs.text:
Mission 7: Molten Stronghold.

The League is in posession of a precious transit hub located inside of a volcano. This proves extremely valuable for power generation and for logistics. Unfortunately and ironically, very few resources are found inside. Therefore, we have authorised the use of material receivers shipping directly from nearby colonial holdings. Protect them at all cost.

docs.title: Rivertide
docs.text:
Mission 8: Rivertide.

Go forth downstream. The enemy is in the process of constructing a new airbase. Their lines of defenses aren't well established. Resources are extremely scarce. Our supply ships and resource receivers bring you the key to victory. Secure and protect them. Cut off their ability to contest the skies. Airstrikes are imminent.

docs.title: Toxopid Showdown
docs.text:
Mission 9: Toxopid Showdown.

The League of Independant States was pushed back to the far reaches of the islands without much resources. Our aerial supremacy allows High Command to direct any and all resources to your aid. Artillery strikes are imminent.

docs.title: Nuclear Deconstruction
docs.text:
Extra Mission 13: Nuclear Deconstruction.

Special gamemode bonus mission. No enemies are present to torment you on this sector. Decontruction via Mega payload carrying is the only viable way to obtain materials.

Harvest as many resources as you can and gain the highest possible score.

docs.title: Depth Charges
docs.text:
Extra Mission 14: Depth Charges: Attack Variation.

Bonus mission. The staple resource of this map is scrap, hidden within the scrap walls. Rarer resources are coal and thorium. An underground sea is hidden beneath the scrap walls.

docs.title: Lightning Snakes
docs.text:
Extra Mission 15: Lightning Snakes.

Bonus mission. This sector is split between our forces, the League and the blue faction. The lack of resources for power is important, perhaps we can flank, take out the enemy blue faction, and take over their base?

docs.title: Primary Interplanetary Accelerator
docs.text:
Primary electromagnetic railgun tower. Accelerates primary cores to the Planet Faraway to escape velocity for interplanetary deployment.

Used to unlock the Planet Lysetta faraway, beginning your journey of Mod Fire.

Property Value General Health 1200 Size 5x5 Build Time 130 seconds Build Cost 13k 13k 3.2k 6.5k 6.5k Power Power Use 600 power units/second Items Item Capacity 1800 items Input/Output Input 1.0k Copper 800 Lead

*Journey's Beginning.

According to the compulsory education physics knowledge on Serpulo: Consider two objects designated as A and B. When object A is subjected to a force with constant magnitude m*v²/R (where m represents A's mass, v its velocity, and R the distance from A to a fixed point) that always points toward this fixed point, A will perform uniform circular motion around that point. This force acting on A is called centripetal force. However, when expanding the perspective: If object B exists at the fixed point, with both objects possessing sufficient mass and separation distance, and B being significantly more massive than A, both A and B will experience mutually equal gravitational forces in opposite directions according to the law of universal gravitation. For the less massive object A, this gravitational force can effectively serve as the centripetal force for circular motion, creating the appearance of A orbiting around nearly stationary B.

This theory was proposed on Serpulo over a millennium ago. Brilliant scientists had already considered applying this principle to celestial bodies, hoping to develop interstellar travel methods for interplanetary deployment and galactic colonization through such research. Yet formidable theoretical challenges followed: According to the gravitational force formula F=GMm/R² (where G is the gravitational constant, M and m the masses, R the separation distance), escape velocity requirements dictate that for an object to overcome gravitational pull, it must satisfy mv²/R>GMm/R², simplifying to v>√(GM/R).

Through persistent efforts, scientists successfully measured R, M and G within the subsequent two centuries, ultimately calculating the required velocities. However, constrained by the applied research department's technological limitations, they struggled to determine viable methods for safely accelerating payloads to these critical speeds. The breakthrough came during the campaign at Planetary Launch Terminal, where captured enemy prototype blueprints inspired them to develop a "primary" electromagnetic acceleration system they claimed as "their own".

Curiously, within two minutes of the applied research department announcing successful development, near-Serpulo satellites sequentially detected unidentified signals of varying intensities...*

docs.title: Lysetta
docs.text:
A planet with intricate connections to Serpulo, while possessing more advanced technology than it. Unfortunately, a certain force has already taken the lead.

More campaign maps will be available in the future.

docs.title: Branched Rivers
docs.text:
A section of the Eteriver. River there branches into multiple tributaries, providing rapid access to surrounding sectors. However, the turbulent currents here appear to have swept away most mineral deposits, and the crisscrossing waterways grant enemy naval forces exceptional mobility, making the region strategically vulnerable. A covert base along the riverbank had been established. Detectors have scanned unidentified type of liquid pumps and tanks nearby. While enemy forces are unlikely to arrive imminently, if the base is detected, they could swiftly deploy via the river to besiege us.

Secure the area to research advanced water extraction, purification, and storage technology. Establish a forward operating base for expanded territorial control.

docs.title: Spore Fiord
docs.text:
After Darksand Peak-forest, this sector was detected. An amount of enemy force has been already stationed here. The detection signs indicate that there was already some kind of force trying to confront the enemy before out arrival, but they failed. Eradicate enemies, capture the sector and research advanced material processing technology and primary spore cultivation technology.

Enemies will begin their attack in a short time, build up defenses as soon as possible.

docs.title: Desert Wastes
docs.text:
Desert's central zone. Numerous factories were once built here, but few remain. Resources are scarce, yet wastes are vast, and criss-crossed with derelict sector structures.

Enemies have seized the initiative, establishing small-scale material processing facilities. Main forces haven't yet reached this remote site - defenses remain lax. HQ will dispatch reinforcements to clear the area. Stay vigilant against enemy reserves, destroy their main forces, and research advanced material processing tech.

docs.title: Frozen Wall
docs.text: This sector is a canyon. The high mountains on both sides stretch out, eventually enclosing the sector ahead. Radar cannot penetrate these mountains to scan the sector ahead,which has caught our attention.This is the only route to that sector. The enemy has built massive defenses here, seemingly to guard against something coming from ahead.Regardless, we must thwart all the enemy's schemes. Moreover, the enemy here is using two new turrets, so we must capture this place.

docs.title: Glaciated Peaks
docs.text:
Breaking through the blockade north of the enemy in Dark Workshop, HQ dispatched a large number of detectors to confirm whether there were any enemy forces continuing to advance. One of the detectors went missing while passing through the area, and the last image it transmitted was of an electromagnetic razorblade tearing it in half.

The enemy has established a large base on the peaks, take it down. HQ will constantly dispatch reinforcements.

docs.title: Dark Workshop
docs.text: Further inland lies the enemy factories. There seems to be abandoned, but still has enemy units and installations. There also contains lots of production facilities. Capture enemy cores, leave nothing standing, research their tech. Allied units are strengthened, try using units to attack.

docs.title: Eteriver Stronghold
docs.text:
One of many parts of Eteriver. Tt is detected that enemy has used a kind of new turret that we have never seen. Capture the area to clear the threats around the Darksand Peak-forest, and research the new turret.

Detection radar indicates that an unknown large unit skulks there, build high-tier turrets to defend enemy's sudden attack.

docs.title: Darksand Peak-forest
docs.text:
Having broken through the outpost base, we arrived at this area of peak forests. The mineral resources here are relatively abundant, with a large number of thermal resources waiting to be developed. However, the bad news is that an enemy force has stationed on the other side of the river, enabling them to quickly launch counterattack measures.

Utilize the existing technology and resources to annihilate the enemies, occupy here and develop as much as possible.

docs.title: Beach Landing
docs.text:
After occupying the Frozen Ground, several construction ships were dispatched, which drifted here along the river. The enemies here possess knowledge of timber processing technology and hydroelectric generation technology. Destroy the enemy base, attempt to research their technologies, and use this place as a springboard to advance into the Antarctic region.

We have also detected several unknown types of turrets. However, due to the lack of materials, we are unable to conduct research on them.

docs.title: Landing Base
docs.text: Shortly after capturing the planetary launch terminal, the near-serpulo satellite received an unknown hostile signal. After investigation, it was found that the signal was transmitted from this distant planet. After multiple scans, this location was selected as the landing point. Destroy the base, capture the sector.

docs.title: Lava Stronghold
docs.text:
Having disintegrated the enemy forces in Scorching Volcano, it's time to deal a counter-blow to the North Pole. Enemy forces have built a complete defence and coupled the high temperature. Large allied units were unable to be delivered here, making the stronghold hard to capture.

However, remember the blue, light strike ships in Desolate Fortification? They were actually the elite units seized by allied forces in the latest attack here. Anyway, flying detector has found the equipment used to summon these strike ships here.

Allied forces have established a base here. Take over the base, leave nothing standing, research their tech.

docs.title: Chilly Mountains
docs.text:
The lifeless mountains. Records show here contains the tech of a brand-new, efficient generator.

Here stands reinforced enemy forces, don't be fooled by the long spacing between enemy attacks.

docs.title: Frozen Ground
docs.text:
After eliminating the threat in the Darksand Peak-forest, an old workshop site was detected. It is suspected to have been a private workshop belonging to the original inhabitants of this planet, but was later abandoned due to the area's barrenness. The returning detector brought us the news we were looking for: there is a new type of factory ruin here that we have never seen before, but it is also occupied by enemies that pose a deadly threat to the research team.

Occupy this site and provide more advanced factories for logistical support.

docs.title: Rubble Ridge
docs.text:
Amidst the mountain ranges, we discovered the remnants of a concealed factory complex. Despite the severely depleted mineral resources in this area, the scale of the ruins is unexpectedly vast, raising significant suspicion. Our analysis suggests two hypotheses: 1. The site may have once been resource-rich, but geological shifts buried the mineral veins beneath the mountains. However, the structural coherence of the ruins contradicts this theory, as the materials’ durability would not withstand such cataclysmic changes. 2. The site likely employed a brand-new extraction facility capable of bypassing conventional mining limitations. Preliminary scans strongly support the second hypothesis. Capture this sector and research the extraction facility.

Note that the region’s unique topography is dominated by an anomalous electromagnetic cloud. Any attempt to deploy overmass cores (e.g. Core: Nucleus, Core: Bulwark) will trigger immediate detonation when making landing. Reinforcements cannot be dispatched either.

docs.title: Stormy Coast
docs.text:
Following a tributary of the Eteriver, we arrived in this coastal area where the detector indicated a small enemy force stationed nearby. After a fierce battle, this is now the last remaining stronghold.

However, the enemy's reinforcements far exceeded our estimates, with the radar map showing a large enemy force swarming towards the area, including elite force. Additionally, through the images transmitted back by the detector from behind enemy lines, we discovered it appears to be a spore contamination source, where the enemy has established a small flesh research facility.

Regardless, repelling enemy's attack and capture this sector, research th e preliminary tech of Flesh, and gain an advantage for future maritime operations.

The weather may be quite severe, please take necessary preparations.

docs.title: Tainted Estuary
docs.text: Having captured Branched Rivers, HQ had continuously deployed detectors to survey upstream conditions, with this estuary area being one of the results. Blanketed with spores, this sector proves ideal for mycological research. Regrettably, enemy forces have already established a stronghold here, fortifying the area with exceptionally high defensive measures. Previous detector deployments have alerted the enemy, leaving us limited operational time. Employ the technology researched from Branched Rivers to completely eradicate all their cores and attain critical information regarding Flesh-about technology. HQ will transmit relevant technical data shortly after landing - ensure to take research promptly. Be advised that enemy forces periodically activate Javelin pads to summon strike ship reinforcements. Maintain constant anti-air readiness to counter these aerial threats.

docs.title: Desolate Fortification
docs.text: After Dark Workshop, allied forces were sent to develop the sectors nearby. This sector seems to have been developed by enemy. As a consequence, this sector was taken over quickly. But now, it has been detected that enemy forces are approaching here. Fend off the enemies and capture this sector. The original frontline will be soon destructed after ~10 waves, build up defense made up of missile turret "Distance" asap.

docs.title: Scorching Volcano
docs.text:
As we went deeper into the North Pole, the volcanic zone in this area was located, which is one of the most violent plates in Lysetta. "A pure hell..."This is what flying detector showed on its screen after returning from there.

Pay attention to repairing buildings damaged by the earthquake in time, and defend the large number of troops sent by enemy.

docs.title: Datachip: Genesis Era
docs.text:
*During a peaceful period on serpulo, A faction known as the Generians settled on the planet. This marked the start of the Genesis Era.

The Generians were a peaceful faction. Till one fateful day during one of the many core launching procedures.

A core was effected by the Protoplasmic Radiation damaging its AI core. The rogue core AI called Terra eventually ended up landing in the craters where soon eventually eradicated the Generians, Marking the end of the Genesis Era.*

docs.title: Datachip: First erdadication
docs.text:
*Year: 75 - Second generation

After the end of the genesis era, More defect cores started appearing on serpulo. So much so it started the event known as the first eradication.

A skirmish endured on as many factions rised and fell. At its peak, the war ran by 3 big factions and a number of small factions.

These factions include: - Terra - Mala - Extelus - Proto, Cellus and Gillar

The war ended after the exhaustion of resources on serpulo.*

docs.title: Datachip: Exhaustion
docs.text:
*Year: 127 - Third generation

A short period of peace after the first eradication. Only lasted for 5 years.

The most of the remaining factions had to further secure there sectors and scrap from destroyed units.

Other small factions eventually died off, either from the lack of resources or other larger factions.

This allowed small factions to pick each other out. Further allowing them to solidify themselves.

[Remaining details unimportant...]*

docs.title: Sharded
docs.text:
* Appearance: fifth generation

One of the last rouge cores that remained on serpulo

Had taken part in the third eradication

The greatest faction of all

the only faction to have truly conquered serpulo

Now they gaze upon the stars as they search for a new place to call their home

Unbeknownst to them they would only reignite the same cycle so many had to endure through

the same mistake

How credulous *

docs.title: Aftermath
docs.text:
Remnants of a production site

A portion of the site still remains largely intact

Though the surviving core has losted it's capability to build any photon panels

Defend the remaining photon panels and take out the remaining enemy forces

docs.title: Helium
docs.text:
Property Value Author EBwilson Repository https://github.com/eb-wilson/helium Stars 54 Last updated 2026-05-05T04:45:16Z

A mod provide optimized ui and more utilities.Major features:- In-Game Entity Information Components: Provides various UI elements for game entities including units and blocks- Health & Status Indicators: Displays real-time status (health, shields) above units and entities. When shield stacks exceed max health, multi-layer shields with stack counters are shown.- Attack Range Indicators: Units and turrets now visualize their attack ranges as translucent areas. Processed boundaries emphasize combined team range contours to prevent visual clutter, with subtle pulsating animations and chromatic borders.- Functional Block Effect Range Indicators: Devices like Mend Projectors, Overdrive Projectors, and unit repair stations display effect ranges with distinctive colors.- Enhanced Block Placement Panel: A refined block selection panel integrating a quick item bar and standardized tool buttons.- The better Mod Manager and Mod Browser: Reworked the Mods Manager and Mods Browser, now they looks more aesthetically pleasing and functional

A mod made by CD, meowkitty and 7rodo that overhauls the campaign, significantly modifying Serpulo's campaign and adding a new planet, Fieros.Amidst the features in this mod are:- 18 New Turrets to defend with- 21 New Units to attack with- 16 New campaign Sectors to play on, including 2 Remakes of vanilla sectors- Post-Surge Alloy-tier content for Serpulo- 12 New Miscellaneous blocks to mess around with on Serpulo⚠ This mod moves Serpulo sectors around without moving their saves, backup your game data in [ SETTINGS > GAME DATA ] before enabling/disabling this mod to prevent campaign corruption if you have any campaign saves. ⚠Discord: https://discord.gg/9YHA3q8HHq

docs.title: Scourged Rivers

*On a planet far far away, a sector's machinery and core went on its schedule like any other, units and materials meant to be inspected and sent of to other sectors were the norm in minor outposts like these, but as the day progressed several objects were detected, moving at a rapid pace, at first the core did not register these pings as a potential threat as attacks at its sector were almost nonexisten, nonetheless the core issued a report, then went dark merely a few later, however nothing was thought out of the ordinary, only after days of silence and reports of undelivered materials did the main core send out an scout to uncover what happened to the outpost, to which it found signs of weapons fire, unbeknownst to the rest of the Cluster it would be the first sign that something was wrong as not even a few days later another sector would go dark, then another would suffer the same fate, alarmed by this the main core of the planet sent out task force after task force to hunt down these units, what they found would be the final broadcast of the planet.

Much like the Strahl, the HIVE is a unit tha is not known very well, only after reports of a destroyed world brought about by the HIVE did concerns flare up, as rumors spread becoming ever distorted from reality fear came along with it. While it is not yet known what its true capability are, many are certain that it is significantly more powerful than anything currently in their arsenals, news that a quarantine and the reassigning of fleets to that system only fueled peoples fears futher.

While the creators and their intentions for making this unit remains unknown, it is known for certain is that the mentioned sector its planet were nothing more than a mere testing ground. Many believe that the destruction of the planet was prelude to something big, many more still deny its existence but with the increasing efficiency of living metal units starting to become much more apparent, more and more are going to face reality that someone or something out there can destroy their world and bring a wave of tyranny.

Whatever the case maybe an arms race with innovations and weaponry never seen before has been sparked, fueled by fears and distrust of the other, one could only hope that this would be the end.*

*Often regarded as a staple unit among many militaries in the Cluster. The Areus drone is a cheap attack drone that can devastate enemy formations and bases in the right conditions. Originally designed as a fast interceptor craft it was later reworked into a glass cannon like unit with low speed and abysmally fragility, to make up for its fragility the unit has twin high damage lancer beams .

While the Areus by itself is very vulnerable and can be easily shot down, swarms of drones can be a dangerous opponent for any enemy formation or base, news of these drone swarms crippling or even overwhelming the defenses of bases are not uncommon.

As technology continues to advance so will the weapons of militaries in the Cluster, the Areus drone may become outdated replaced with new better units, with the advent of living steel it is only matter of time before it gets replaced by something that can unleash far more carnage on the Cluster.*

This design was cut down to be as light as possible to be quickly cosntructed and deployed. Crystals would be crushed in the base, stored in the drum for quick feeding and then be accellerated. The drum was placed on the opposite side of the accelerator to shift the center of mass towards the middle, enabling quick turning. The design's fragility was easly compensated for with walls from its front, but sustained fire would quickly destroy it.

Scrapyard leaves no further routes to explore Ikaru. Backtracking from Creek is the only way fowards. The branching path ahead will further provoke the Meld.

Aerial threats will come from the north. Use Sunder turrets to counter them.

Objective: Survive Weather: Foggy

-Carbolith depleted -3 Meld Amplifiers spotted!

...why does it sound like missiles are inbound?

docs.title: Remenant
docs.text:
Datamine!

Abandoned and entombed with crystaline megaliths.

Huge swarms of flying and artillery constructs have been recorded, along with an unknown eradication tier threat.

Dredge and process as many research materials as you can, untill the waves overwhelm you.

There is no Resonarum in this sector. Nullifiers inaccesable!

Objective: Dredge

-Resonarum depleted -2 Meld Amplifiers spotted! -Spawning pools spotted!

An endless battle, a meaningless victory, and a story to tell. I can hear their voices still linger.

docs.title: Scrapyard
docs.text:
Filled with Debris and Silver, but lacking in Carbolith. Deploy new infusion technology.

The landing area is resource deprived, be ready to attack!

Objective: Survive Weather: Hazy

-Carbolith depleted

-1 Meld Amplifier spotted!

The wildlife explodes?

docs.title: Shear
docs.text:
Scrapyard leaves no further routes to explore Ikaru. Backtracking from Creek is the only way fowards. The branching path ahead will further provoke the Meld.

Meld attacks will switch sides after every burst, starting from the west front.

Friendly signals have been detected... be ready for anything!

Objective: ??? Weather: Australian

-2 Meld Amplifiers spotted!

The tactics never grew, but the hand opened.

docs.title: Slumber
docs.text:
This planet hasn't solidified yet...

You've done well to make it this far.

Objective: ??? Weather: ???

*A meaningless victory it was not. Meaning was given the moment they started to fight.

This isn't right. Shoudn't there be more?

Maybe im using the wrong map.*

docs.title: Tempest in a Teacup
docs.text:
Another Strata instance has already setup a base here, and moved on.

Harsh weather had been observed in response to activity, so the base lies dormant in a divot.

Ensure you don't get overwhelmed by the heavy storms, and keep your units repaired.

Objective: Weather the storm Weather: Clear, then Torrential, then Clear

-2 Meld Amplifiers spotted! -Quick Start!

...there were others?

Before you'll play this mod, let me tell you that skill and patience are highly required.You need to learn from your mistakes and lost battles in order to complete some sectors.Welcome to the Frozen farlands,here, where there is no such thing called heat, Serpulo's Moon Awaits you!Zilo, a place colonized by Bushark the fraction from Tantros,Even if that's only a moon there are many new things, new resources, blocks, units, turrets, just everything.There is one more place we would like you to visit... GheţarA Lonely Asteroid orbiting behind Zilo,Maybe it's a small place but it doesn't means it is going to be easy in there, but surely you'd be having fun...This mod contains custom soundtracks, please do not steal them... instead get a better vibe while playingAnd Thanks to Świrek for helping us with code.We hope you'll enjoy our modThis Isn't our last creation, we have a huge plans upcoming, if you are interested in our plans, concepts and updates join our discord serverOur contributtors: RouterXdd, Silin Veredno and Catana8735link: https://discord.gg/TQTW3mfYyfWe also have it on a disboard.

docs.title: CrashLanding
docs.text:
A land devastated by a spaceship that crashed here, maybe we can find new technology?

The first spaceship that has ever entered this solar system has exploded due to unknown reasons, about half of it is crashed right here,the other half can be found on Serpulo. Due to the thin atmosphere of Zilo, the ship has straight up impacted the land instead of burning while falling.

docs.title: Cryo River
docs.text: A river of Cryofluid with remnants of an old enemy base. Capture it to push back our enemies.

docs.title: The Fortress
docs.text:
The greatest base that Bushark has ever built. Many attacks were already launched here, none of which were successful. They have an unimaginably powerful super weapon guarding their main entrance, this base is extremly guarded. The more time you spend defending, the harder it gets. Your base will be constantly attacked, you have to launch succesful counter attacks in order to survive. If you manage to capture this base, the whole of Zilo will be under our control.

The first and strongest base of Bushark, at first it was planned to only be a research facility. Upon stumbeling on the fragmental technology and realizing it's potential, they decided to keep researching it. After years they had invented first weapons such as the Defragmentation but this was not enough. They had found a way to trigger a chain reaction beetwen atoms affected by fragmental split which at first seemed impossible. Then they had created this superweapon, Restart was the only project that used this new fragmental technology, it is almost a technological miracle, we would never be able to research it. But Bushark are inventors, they love new tech. Unfortunately, once you have destroyed everything here, we will not get new information but at least we will have an entire planet for ourselves.

docs.title: Frontline
docs.text: We are preparing for our final target, main base of Bushark on Zilo, also known as The Fortress, they already know our plans and they are throwing everything at us, if you will be able to defend yourself, we can launch an attack on The Fortress.

docs.title: Ground Sub Zero
docs.text:
The perfect place for your first steps on Zilo, collect new materials, research new technology and destroy the enemy outpost nearby.

This outpost... it is not Crux... Bushark? A faction from Tantros? What do they want from this planet?

docs.title: Lonely Lake
docs.text: A öake of cryofluid located around mountains, Maybe we can use it to research new technologies?

docs.title: Secret Passage
docs.text: Our next primary target is another enemy base located along the sunny mountains, sadly the terrain does not allows us to attack it straight up, we have to get through this claustrophobic ravine...

docs.title: Solar Peaks
docs.text:
One of 2 main bases of Bushark on Zilo, their technology far surpasses yours but there is no turning back now, eradicate everything and steal their technology.

A base built on a stategical place, Bushark is here mainly because of the terrain. Bushark thinks that it is impossible to approach it from any side but you found a small ravine and made your way through it.

docs.title: The Asylum
docs.text:
A vast place located on an asteroid. Here, Bushark from Zilo has teamed up with the Crux from Serpulo to get revenge on you. Once you defeat them, the whole asteroid will be under your control. These two factions will not give you an easy victory, you have really made them mad...

*This asteroid is a peaceful distant place with plenty of resources, When Bushark noticed your presence there, they have alerted the Crux and both factions agreed to team up. They are focused solely on destroying you. *

docs.text: A cave used for transporting resources and goods, we have to weaken our enemies. Take over this place and eradicate every enemy in your path.

"North Abyss has a fish, its name is Kun. The Southern Seas have a cannon, its name is Eternal.Its length is several hundred meters, its diameter several dozen meters. Once it turns to fire, meteors pass overhead, the sky flushes crimson. Upon detonation, the horizon blazes bright, as though purple clouds descend from the heavens, annihilating all foes.The lords are struck with fear, forming alliances to weaken Qin. The gates are opened to meet it, yet they hesitate and dare not advance.In negotiations, they demand the project be cut in half, but to no avail. For decades they dare not ride south to pasture their horses." ? excerpt from Eternal.Its cost, scale, and deterrent power are unprecedented. Under pressure, it is prohibited from deployment at overseas bases, with assurances it will not be used first.The arduous R&D process and enormous costs once caused the project to be suspended.Indeed, the massive consumption of all kinds of resources would make an already not-wealthy company even worse off. docs.title: New Console Hardline
docs.text:
Property Value Author Mnemotechnician (original developer), SMOLKEYS (port maintainer) Repository https://github.com/smolkeys/new-console-hardline Stars 13 Last updated 2026-02-19T14:17:45Z

The officially acknowledged port of New Console for v147-above.Adds a console UI superior to the built-in one and the ones provided by any other mods.User-friendly interface, an actual code editor with syntax highlighting and indentation guides, assistance and more:A good log panel, execution history - all of that is included in this mod.In addition to the console, this mod offers:- An ability to save as many scripts as you want and to either execute them or copy to the console- An ability to execute scripts when certain events get fired- A full-blown file browser (be careful, you can cause real harm with that!)See README.md for more info.

docs.text: Out in the deserts lay these arid plateaus. This area lacks major enemy control due to its void of resources. However, the ruins have shown major evidence of a minor enemy base housing a heli-pad and helicopter-type unit factories. Though this area may seem empty, do not be fooled, as the enemy sends large aerial attack forces to fend any cores from this land. Crash their forces and obtain this technology.

docs.title: Ferric Plains
docs.text:
An adequate place to start the conquest on this poison-filled planet. Gather as much iron and Scorchonite as possible. Charren is sending their meager forces at you, detecting a new base in the vicinity. Do not let them take the sector from you.

Attacker: Charren

docs.title: Magmatic Caverns
docs.text:
In the caves of Recuder lay a volcanic hotspot. This area is rich in positive affinities for heat harvesters.

Charren has set up a base here, however. Forge Tritonium, produce ground units, and siege their base whilst surviving seperate enemy assaults.

Attacker: Charren

docs.title: Poison Bay Caves
docs.text:
Poison has infested this planet and its oceans. Cobalt reserves have been detected here. Use these reserves and to automate the collection of resources and fend off Fusionix's forces.

Attacker: Fusionix

docs.title: Ragged Wastelands
docs.text: Centuries of harsh winds and scorching heat have molded this once beautiful coastline into a rough wasteland. Silver, a rare metal on Serpulo, is present here. The enemy has stationed many unique naval troops around this location. Eradicate the enemy invasions and collect as much resources as possible. Research these unique fighting units.

docs.title: Scorched Skalelands
docs.text:
In the east region of Ducelio lies a large stretch of skale rock. Not much poison has claimed this area, but there are numerous selevite clusters in its reach.

Charren is once again sending troops to dispatch of your base. Defend against them, harvest selevite and sulfur, smelt amberglass, and pump slag to use in turrets.

Attacker: Charren

docs.title: Toxic Estuary
docs.text:
Ruins lay here from another faction that attempted to conquer this sector many years ago. Charren had sieged their base and will siege any new bases landing on this sector. What remains is the bridge connecting the continents of Anveltria and Ducelio.

Harvest Antimony, forge Light Alloy, research new tech, and survive Charren's raid. Charren's new mechs are capable of walking over walls, so you must use new turrets to slow their advance.

Attacker: Charren

docs.title: Thanaras
docs.text: A dark, isolated planet that happened to fly by the Serpulo Erekir Solar System a few centuries ago and got into orbit around their sun. There was a struggle between factions as they tried to conquer the planet despite its hostile nature and... seemingly alive celestial body, yet it appears something seems to have been reawakened in the presence of warmth... something sinister that the Korru, the Green faction that currently occupies Thanaras, is obliviously unaware of.

docs.title: Arche Ruin
docs.text: As punishment for your INCREDIBLY lackluster performance at operating a high value resource sector in Serpulo, you have been sent to a planet almost beyond the reaches of this solar system, a cold and sinister planet called Thanaras. Mystery fills the atmosphere, dread lurking at every corner, but, as fate may have it, you are not alone in this supposedly desolate wasteland. Figure out the inner workings of this planet's tech and hope to survive the onslaught of waves that will come your way.

docs.title: Cratorial Super Quarry
docs.text: Two large craters formed from asteroid impacts a long long time ago are riddled with plentiful resources such as nickel, titanium, and tungsten. Legend says the asteroid had split in two before impact, causing the two distinct side-by-side craters imprinted on this quarry today. The Korru have been using this sector as a means of collecting large quantities of said resources, and have used this super quarry as a research lab and testing grounds aswell, with powerful Anti Aircraft Technology that inhibits enemy flying units from trespassing into their territory, automatically smiting them down when they come into range of the weapons. Utilize the Tier 3 Hover and Crawler units as well as the Unit Cap of the new core to target their weak spots and capture the sector.

docs.title: Desperation Canyon
docs.text: In the face of a large canyon stretching across the vion plains, the Korru have switched to a mostly all-out air assault, allowing them to fly over the canyon with ease. Fortunately, preparing this air siege takes some time, giving you a few minutes to prepare for the assault. A warning before you head in, though, and do not take this lightly. Once the attack begins, the wave intervals get so short that waves will be sent despite enemies still being present on the map. Capture the sector and keep your will to fight. This canyon is called Desperation for a reason.

docs.title: Festering Oval
docs.text: The Korru have set up an enemy outpost on this tryphostone infested sector, where they were able to utilize tryphoton to create new compounds and tech discoveries. Capture this enemy base by using the tryphoton to your advantage and your newly unlocked unit factories and destroy the enemy core.

docs.title: Frost Mounds
docs.text: Hidden on the dark side of Thanaras, nitrogen has deposited into many frozen mounds, complete with sharp crystals that litter around them. A most unfortunate predicament would have to be the lack of tryphoton and sand in this region, slowing down production and progression by an incomprehensible amount. Use your newly researched Crumbler and Annexion Generators to get past these limitations and capture this sector.

docs.title: Green Valley
docs.text: This sector, full of decaying rocks and stones, is littered with a plentiful amount of radioactive uranium. The conditions on here may not be ideal, and the intricate siege of units that are sent wave after wave will be hard to hold back. Despite this, use the resources at your disposal to capture this sector and continue with your conquest.

docs.title: Infested Grounds
docs.text: With patches of sand craters spread out across a tryphoton-consumed landscape, this field full of pure tryphoton rock marks the beginning of an all out branch in all directions of discovery. Defend and capture this sector to unlock multiple new research branches and tech that will help you in your adventure. Beware though, the Korru won't let you get off that easily.

docs.title: Luminescent Tendrils
docs.text: Lengthy patches of tryphostone have stretched across this land not long ago. This opened pure tryphonic scars that threatened to overtake the region, if it weren't for a mysterious new growing mineral called vion, diving the land in two and preventing the two tendrils from connecting. Use your newly researched tech to conquer this sector and discover more about the inner workings of this planet.

docs.title: Maze Of Gibberish
docs.text: Groups of vion gemstones litter the surrounding area, causing blockages and winding pathways that force units to travel across a maze of distorted proportions. Patches of lone tryphoton rock are found around the sector, as the march of Vion enemies tremble the ground with their agility and power. Vion boulders are plentiful across the maze, creating illusions that trick you into thinking they are walls, but do not be deterred. Set up defense and capture this sector despite the Vion onslaught brought down upon you.

docs.title: Miscellaneon
docs.text: You may have noticed units that aren't part of the micro family tree appearing throughout different sectors to aid in your demise. These units are much more powerful than the micro units, both in shape and form, with each family having their own unique set of abilities. This sector contains all 3 biomes that depict each of the Mega units, as they're called: the vion quartz representing the flaming and quick Vion family; the frozen ice sheets being the environment in which the Shadow family thrives; and the decaying and toxic stones where the Nuclear family originates from. Capture this sector in the face of this mega onslaught and move on with your conquest.

docs.title: Perilous Stream
docs.text: This sector, although unharming at first, is a cascade of aggression and shock. Intel suggests that the Crux have adopted a new strategy of making you feel comfortable with the first few waves before bringing everything out on your vulnerable defense. Be alert, and take refuge as not one, but TWO copies of a Champion have been spotted waiting for the right moment to strike.

docs.title: Reconcite
docs.text: This sector seems to hold the key to the discovery of more research, as well as more tech on monolite. Capture it, and beware as rumors of another Champion are said to be arriving.

docs.title: Reverent Junction
docs.text: Traces of a new mineral ore have been discovered here, one that unlocks a new wave of tech that can be used for various purposes. Proceed with caution, however, as the Crux have managed to obtain this resource as well and are currently testing out the power of this new tech on you.

docs.title: River of Floe
docs.text: Despite the harsh and cold conditions of this sector, the tryphoton has somehow found a way to survive, spreading even here in the freezing climate. The nitrogenous ice, however, has managed to flow through the organic rock and create a frozen river, filled with more of these frost mounds all over the place. Unfortunately, the tryphoton has been able to consume these mounds and warp them into their own radioactive blobs, which creates a winding maze full of obstacles you need to traverse. Capture this sector by using the environment to your advantage and beware the final wave.

docs.title: Shoal Depth
docs.text: Another sector has been found harboring the strange new resource, however intel has been discovered on a new weapon the Crux have been working on that has been identified as Champions. One of these Champions are suspected to arrive on this sector any wave now, so get ready.

docs.title: Tryphoton Research Facility
docs.text: Here lies the remains of countless derelict tech that has been left to rot over decades, most of which have been destroyed. This sector also introduces tungsten and multiple other structures that you will need to survive. Capture this sector to unlock new ways to use this mysterious tryphoton resource.

docs.title: Vion Plateau
docs.text: This once barren plateau has been overtaken by this vion material, turning it into a large amalgamation of different mineral floors and resources. Proceed with caution, however, as the Korru have set up three different spawn points throughout the lengthy flat. It appears there is a new resource here that they hope they obtain, so capture this sector and discover this item before they do.

docs.title: Viridescent Plain
docs.text: Amidst the mass extinction caused by the spore breakout, a piece of land known as the Viridescent Plain has managed to sustain life, a wide array of greenery populating its surface. Perhaps it was the workings of a new resource located here that the grass was able to survive and grow, but you better have your head up because the Crux have sent yet another Champion to take you down.

docs.title: Xechas
docs.text: By some miracle of whatever mindustrian forces are out there, this small patch of land remained unaffected by the harsh conditions that destroyed and shaped Thanaras' landscape. It gives you a glimpse into what Thanaras once was; a planet full of alien life that makes no sense whatsoever, yet beautiful in its own way. With titanium-infused soils and yellow kitri plant life, this small isolated sector remains disconnected from the outside, seemingly through the power of the large derelict structure located at its core, now spent and rotting away into the flora it desperately protected.

docs.title: Zeus' Domain
docs.text: The name of this sector, called Zeus' Domain, may be in relation to the fact that the final wave will be... a shocking experience, to say the least. Mutliple biomes fused into one; tryphostone, titanar, nitrogenous ice, decayed stone, all present. Utilizing the resources scattered in all directions, defeat the onrush of waves and prove yourself ruler of this domain.

docs.title: Ancient Swamp
docs.text: A massive dried up and nearly dead swamp is present in this sector. Large amounts of enemies will be attacking here. Mine peat and research Blast Compound to be able to defend more effectively.

docs.title: Cavern
docs.text: (Optional challenge sector) Inside lies a small cave with abundant resources. The enemy units will attack soon. Use the materials to hold off the invasion.

docs.title: Craterous Range
docs.text: A strong enemy base was set up between these mountains. Research the Support Unit Recombiner and use the Helix units to destroy the enemy base.

docs.title: Depository Crevice
docs.text: (Optional challenge sector) The enemy is trying to set up a base in this region. Destroy the enemy forces before they finish constructing it.

docs.title: Dried River
docs.text: This giant field of salt was once a river, before it was destroyed by the Incineration. Build units and research new, more advanced materials to destroy the enemy base.

docs.title: Enfer
docs.text: (Optional sector) Sensors detect low enemy activity, there is a small outpost located nearby. The drop zones in the sector are inactive.

docs.title: Eroded Desert
docs.text: A large desert with abundant resources. Research new tech such as aerogel and ammonia production to build new turrets and defeat the enemy forces.

docs.title: Evaporated Basin
docs.text: The enemies have set up a medium Blast Compound production base in this passage. Use Frontline units to destroy their core.

docs.title: Excavation Site
docs.text: A small enemy quartz production base. A massive quicksand lake exists in this sector. Unknown how it formed. Prototype hovercraft unit production is in the limited enemy base here. They can and will fly over liquids to attack your base.

docs.title: Ferric Summit
docs.text: Most of the space of this mountanous region was captured by the enemy. Research the Support Unit Forge and use the Sine units to break the enemy cores.

docs.title: Landing
docs.text: The first sector on Psammos, mine Osmium and Silver to defend against weak enemy waves.

docs.title: Oil Refining Facility
docs.text: This sector posseses extremely large amounts of oil deposits. Research Seismic Bombs to get through the layers of sand blocking them. Use the new technologies to destroy the enemy base.

docs.title: Quartz Valley
docs.text: A valley with large amounts of resources, use it for production of Quartz, and then Silicon. There will be a large enemy force arriving shortly after landing. Defend and capture the sector.

docs.title: Ruinous Hollow
docs.text: The enemy set up two large bases in this cave. Research tier 2 unit production to destroy them.

docs.title: Scalded Plains
docs.text: This sector is the enemy's memory alloy production. Research the Memory Alloy Crucible for new technologies and destroy the enemy base. You land in a secluded area in the corner of the sector and will need to clear the way to the enemy base using Ammonia Bombs.

docs.title: Searing Chasms
docs.text: The Enemy has set up 4 different outposts in the area, Use 2nd tier units of varying types to conquer them all, beware of the large vortex cannons that defend the enemies

docs.title: Shattered Pathway
docs.text: (Optional challenge sector) Large amounts of bombardment have turned this relatively rich area into a destroyed wasteland flooded with quicksand. Some of the shelling uncovered resources hidden deep beneath the sand, but most of it caused quicksand to form ontop of small oases.

docs.title: Weapon Testing Site
docs.text:
Erimos' now defunct testing site. They developed and tested a weapon of mass destruction in this sector, which seems to have ended badly for them. Capture this sector before the enemy forces reclaim their weapon's blueprints. Research desert glass, a strange and valueable resource which was created in result of the weapon test.

The origin point of the Incineration. Erimos made a mistake in their calculations of the explosion's power. The weapon was so strong it lit the atmoshpere on fire...
